scope: Every tracked file under Nodes, all factory node types and imported node definitions, and connector rendering paths used by palette, previews, adapters, power distros and cable schedules. Runtime user artwork is described by rendering method rather than enumerated.
gender_policy: Gender describes physical artwork only where established; unspecified means source does not declare it. Input/output and one-way/two-way are signal roles, not physical genders. Shared images do not constrain connector gender. PowerLock drain/source and powerCON blue/white names are retained without guessing physical gender.
catalogue_source: src/factoryCatalogueBootstrap.js loads data/factory-catalogue.json; nodeTypes are merged with nodes, then built-in thumbnail migrations apply.

dynamic_and_image_renderers.name: Node palette thumbnail
dynamic_and_image_renderers.rendering_method: DOM img with lazy data-library-src and blank.png error fallback

dynamic_and_image_renderers.name: Engine connector and Node Builder preview
dynamic_and_image_renderers.rendering_method: Dynamic WebGL circular port geometry with white rim; color from connector/effective transceiver module, optional red not-working cross. No thumbnail image is used.
variants: cage with LC singlemode or multimode module

dynamic_and_image_renderers.name: Legacy editor connector
dynamic_and_image_renderers.rendering_method: Dynamic SVG circle or segmented SVG geometry; connector/effective-type color

dynamic_and_image_renderers.name: Multiband connector
dynamic_and_image_renderers.rendering_method: Dynamic colored band polygons clipped to circular port geometry; 5 PowerLock, 3 YPbPr, or 5 RGBHV bands

dynamic_and_image_renderers.name: Adapter thumbnail connector markers
dynamic_and_image_renderers.rendering_method: Dynamic inline SVG from adapter topology: circle markers, multiband polygons, white rims and red not-working crosses; cached by topology

dynamic_and_image_renderers.name: Cable schedule connector graphic
dynamic_and_image_renderers.rendering_method: Dynamic 64x40 Canvas 2D exported as PNG data URL: colored circular marker plus thumbnail artwork; grouped coax uses 3 or 5 small circles instead of artwork

dynamic_and_image_renderers.name: Power distribution physical plug
dynamic_and_image_renderers.rendering_method: Input/output-specific SVG or PNG image; Canvas 2D drawImage in Engine faceplate and SVG image in editor overlay

dynamic_and_image_renderers.name: User-authored connector thumbnail
dynamic_and_image_renderers.rendering_method: Runtime uploaded/assigned artwork cropped on Canvas 2D and saved as 100x100 PNG in node JSON; unbounded user-created variants use the same palette and preview renderers
